text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, June 6, 2018 Posted by admin on June 6th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL), Microsoft (MSFT), Nike (NKE) and Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +111 points.
Tuesday the Dow was down -13.71 (-0.06%) at 24,799.98.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +0.33%.
There were 13 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by DowDuPont (DWDP) +1.13% and Apple (AAPL) +0.77%.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Merck (MRK) -1.02% and Wal-Mart (WMT) -0.94%.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down one-tenth of a cent at $2.941 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
There are no Dow stocks set to report earnings in the near term.
